entities.name: Greek Natural Philosophy
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The intellectual tradition originating with Thales of Miletus (c. 624–546 BCE) that sought natural rather than mythological explanations for the world. This rational inquiry laid the foundations for Western science and philosophy.
